raw:
@q query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "work at"
      role subject ?x
      role object ?c
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be in"
      role subject ?c
      role location "Bălți"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
